c.v: The frame information is one byte long and specifies a message's frame type, frame format, and length of data.
The frame information fields are shown in Table 31.5-4.

blocks.caption: Table 31.5-4. TX/RX Frame Information (SFF/EFF); TWAI Address 0x40

c.v: FF: The Frame Format (FF) bit specifies whether the message is Extended Frame Format (EFF) or Standard Frame Format (SFF).
The message is EFF when FF bit is 1, and SFF when FF bit is 0.
RTR: The Remote Transmission Request (RTR) bit specifies whether the message is a data frame or a remote frame.
The message is a remote frame when the RTR bit is 1, and a data frame when the RTR bit is 0.
X: Don't care, can be any value.
DLC: The Data Length Code (DLC) field specifies the number of data bytes for a data frame, or the number of data bytes to request in a remote frame.
data frames are limited to a maximum payload of 8 data bytes, and thus the DLC should range anywhere from 0 to 8.
